page_title: PAU 0-1 UNI | St. Pauli v Union Berlin 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
90+4' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.

90+1' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by James Sands (St. Pauli), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) will take a corner kick.
87' Substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage will be replaced by Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli).
85' St. Pauli have a corner.
85' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
83' This shall not pass! Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
82' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) replacing Ilyas Ansah.
81' The ratio of the ball possession is 57:43.
77' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
76' The attendance is 29546.
74' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
73' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) comes onto the pitch for Arkadiusz Pyrka.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Aljoscha Kemlein.
73' Here is a change. Tom Rothe is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin).
73' Substitution. Oliver Burke is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin).
71' The linesman raises his flag. Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
70' St. Pauli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' St. Pauli fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
66' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Substitution. Andrej Ilic walks off the pitch and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
64' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute Jackson Irvine and he is replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) comes onto the pitch so that Andreas Hountondji can be given a rest.
63' A cross into the box finds the head of Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) who steers it goalwards, but Frederik Ronnow manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
63' The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner.

60' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tom Rothe (Union Berlin).
58' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) commits a foul after dangerous play. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
56' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
54' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
53' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
52' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) prepares to take a corner kick.
49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
46' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is cautioned by the referee.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' St. Pauli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.

41' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
41' Union Berlin are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
38' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
38' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. St. Pauli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

35' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
29' Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

29' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
26' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
22' A pass by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' The current number of shots on goal is 0:0.
12' Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) takes the corner.
12' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from St. Pauli as they win a corner.
11' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle as Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Union Berlin win a free kick.

9' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick.

6' James Sands (St. Pauli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Union Berlin, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
5' The linesman signals that Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
4' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
